name: Yaprak Sut ve Besi Ciftlikleri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
summary: Yaprak Süt ve Besi Çiftlikleri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in animal husbandry business in Turkey. The company breeds calf, heifers, and dairy animals, as well as provides health service It also operates milk production facilities. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey.
